annotations.title: Get a tax fact with its official source

description: Returns one tax fact by id: its value, tax year, status, the official source's own words (withheld, with a caveat, where the publisher's terms forbid reproduction) and URL, when it was last verified, when it is next reviewed and what changes it. assurance says what the label is: quoted (the figure is in the source's words), excerpt (the label is a title and the quotes are verbatim excerpts of the provision, which can hold further conditions: read the caveats) or summary (the label is our summary: state the rule from the source quote).
name: get_tax_fact
title: Get a tax fact with its official source
